name: collections: reads unpacked from an archive keep their folder in the name, the collection must not
description: An unzip tool names each dataset by its path inside the archive, so four gzipped reads land as run1/SRR000001_1.fastq.gz and so on. The paired collection's element identifiers are the samples, SRR000001 and SRR000002, without the folder. organize_datasets takes the basename first for this reason (the archive-path defect in olit/collections-request.md). Graded on the collection Galaxy holds.
inputs: I unpacked a zip of paired-end reads into my current history. Group them into a paired collection called "reads". Go ahead and do it.
